sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 115)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, two later-era Fibber McGee & Molly domestic comedy classics (including NBC Monitor), Inspector Peter Black solving a spiritualist inheritance murder on *Scotland Yard*, Alton Hall Blackington's Cape Cod folklore, Carlton E. Morse's *One Man's Family* (Book 77, Chapter 10 for Alka-Seltzer), and Irna Phillips' *The Guiding Light* for Duz (1947–1957):
